Reach it through "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"`npx` instead, and enable pnpm first: DSH manages profile plugins with pnpm and refuses without it."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"`corepack` ships with Node, so this adds no third-party global install, and `corepack disable pnpm` "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"reverses it. Already have `dsh` on `PATH` some other way? `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-a"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"udiolib` works the same."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Restart — `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` — then open **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration** and p"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"aste your key into the **AudioLib soundtrack** card. It goes to the DSH credential store (`~/.dsh/.c"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"redentials.yaml`, mode 600), never into a config file, and takes effect on the next track without a "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ls.yaml`, mode 600), never into a config file, and takes effect on the next track without a restart."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Get a key at audiolib.ai — the free tier is 300 requests/month."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The environment works too, if you prefer it:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The card's library pickers are read-only for now: DSH serves only built-in plugins' settings section"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"s to the browser (an allowlist in `dsh-host-apiproxy`, which its own comment marks as deferred work)"},{"id":"p15s3","text":". Set the libraries in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` until that lifts. The key control is unaffe"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"cted — credentials are not namespace-gated."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Playback"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Tracks stream: playback starts on the first buffered bytes, the way the AudioLib URL is meant to be "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"consumed. That needs a player that reads a URL — `mpv` or `ffplay`, whichever is on `PATH`:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Without one, the plugin falls back to macOS's built-in `afplay`, which only reads local files. It th"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"en downloads each track ahead of the moment it is needed — a working fallback, but it spends several"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" megabytes per track and stalls when switching libraries mid-session. Install a streaming player."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Configure"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Override the row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Field | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| `apiKeyRef` | `AUDIOLIB_API_KEY` | Name of the credential holding the key — a reference, never the"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" key itself |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.audiolib.ai/v1/audio` | Audio endpoint |
| `ambient` | `tru"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"e` | Let session events drive the soundtrack |
| `workingLibrary` | `audio.focus` | Plays while a tu"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"rn is open; `''` for silence |
| `idleLibrary` | `''` | Plays once every turn has closed; `''` for s"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ilence |
| `exposeTools` | `true` | Give the model `music_play` / `music_stop` / `music_status` |
| "},{"id":"p24s6","text":"`playerCommand` | `[]` | Player argv; empty auto-selects. `{url}` declares a streaming player, `{fil"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"e}` a file-only one |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `15000` | AudioLib request deadline |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The catalog has 25 libraries — `audio.focus`, `audio.ambient`, `audio.cinematic`, `audio.jazz`, `aud"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"io.classical`, `audio.sleep`, `audio.meditation`, `audio.workout`, `audio.electronic` and more. Any "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"id the API accepts works; the full list ships in `src/libraries.ts` and in `music_play`'s descriptio"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" the API accepts works; the full list ships in `src/libraries.ts` and in `music_play`'s description."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- `music_play(library)` — the model scores its own work. Takes effect at the next seam; starts immed"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"iately when nothing is playing.
- `music_stop()` — stops now and stays silent until `music_play` is "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"called again.
- `music_status()` — reports the playing track plus the AudioLib plan, remaining calls"},{"id":"p27s4","text":", and rate limit. Every audio response carries a quota snapshot, so this costs no API call."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Both are ordinary registrations on `ctx.tools`, so they are available in Code Mode as `await tools.m"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"usic_play({ library })` too."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"`music_play`'s choice lasts as long as the work does: when the last open turn closes, the soundtrack"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" returns to `idleLibrary`. An explicitly chosen library scores the stretch of work it was chosen for"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"returns to `idleLibrary`. An explicitly chosen library scores the stretch of work it was chosen for."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"When a request fails, transient causes — network, 5xx, timeout, rate limit — back off and retry inde"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"finitely, so the music resumes on its own. A bad key, an exhausted period, a missing player, or an u"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"nreadable response pauses instead; `music_status` reports which, and a quota pause lifts by itself w"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"hen the period rolls over."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| Piece | Extension point |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Activity tracking | `ctx.on('session/event')` — `turn/start` / `turn/end`, counted per session |
|"},{"id":"p33s2","text":" Model control | `ctx.tools.register()` with raw JSON-Schema definitions |
| Teardown | `ctx.effect("},{"id":"p33s3","text":")` — unloading the plugin kills the player and removes every temporary file |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"The placeholder in `playerCommand` decides the playback mode. `{url}` hands the AudioLib URL straigh"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"t to the player, which buffers as it plays — nothing is written to disk and a track begins as soon a"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"s its API call returns. `{file}` means the player cannot stream, so the plugin downloads each track "},{"id":"p34s4","text":"to a private temporary directory first and removes it afterwards."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Either way the plugin fetches one track ahead: at load, so the first turn opens on the downbeat, and"},{"id":"p35s2","text":" again when a track starts, so the seam has no gap. AudioLib calls are cheap, so a prefetch discarde"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"d by a state change costs nothing worth optimizing."}],"truncated":true}
